results.title: Admin UI Reset Endpoint Alignment
results.scenario: Verify Admin UI calls authoritative /api/admin/reset without 404 mismatch
results.actual: hasWrongEndpoint: false, hasCorrectEndpoint: true, sendsConfirmText: true

results.title: Admin UI Reset Phrase Alignment
results.scenario: Verify Admin UI prompts and checks exact phrase RESET ALL
results.expected: No CONFIRM RESET check, contains resetPhrase !== "RESET ALL" and placeholder
results.actual: hasWrongPhrase: false, hasCorrectPhrase: true, hasCorrectPlaceholder: true

results.title: FX Queue Settle ACID Wallet Mutation
results.scenario: Settle queued FX request (100,000 INR -> USD); verify atomic debit/credit
results.expected: Status SETTLED, INR debited exactly 100,000, USD credited converted amount

results.title: FX Queue Settle Ledger & Transaction Record
results.scenario: Verify fxTransactions array records ticketNumber, operatorId, and walletsAfter
results.expected: fxTransaction recorded with ticketNumber, operatorId, and valid transaction ID
results.actual: recorded: true, ticketNumber: FX_1794111342155_ole9, operatorId: exchange

results.title: Duplicate FX Ticket Submission Rejection
results.scenario: Submit identical ticketNumber FX-TKT-M0-... twice to /api/fx/exchange
results.expected: Second attempt rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request ("already been processed")
results.actual: HTTP 400 - FX Ticket FX-TKT-M0-1794111344059 has already been processed.

evidence.error: FX Ticket FX-TKT-M0-1794111344059 has already been processed.

results.title: Duplicate FX Ticket Zero-Debit Invariant
results.scenario: Verify wallet was not debited a second time on duplicate ticket rejection
results.expected: INR wallet after duplicate attempt strictly equals wallet after first attempt

results.title: BUY Order Cancellation Reserved Cash Zero-Leak
results.scenario: Cancel BUY order in EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT; verify reservedCash released to baseline
results.expected: Order CANCELLED, reservedCash returns to pre-order level, voucher marked CANCELLED
results.actual: orderStatus: CANCELLED, preBuyReserved: 0, postExecReserved: 4002.6, postCancelReserved: 0, voucherStatus: CANCELLED

results.title: Cancelled Voucher Settlement Prevention
results.scenario: Bank teller attempts to settle voucher from cancelled order
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Cannot settle record in status CANCELLED")
results.actual: HTTP 400 - Cannot settle record in status CANCELLED.

evidence.error: Cannot settle record in status CANCELLED.

results.title: SELL Order Cancellation Holdings Restoration
results.scenario: Cancel SELL order in EXECUTED_PENDING_SETTLEMENT; verify surrendered shares restored
results.expected: Order CANCELLED, holdings restored to pre-order count, voucher marked CANCELLED
results.actual: orderStatus: CANCELLED, preSellHoldings: 10, postExecHoldings: 10, postCancelHoldings: 10, voucherStatus: CANCELLED

results.title: Settled Order Cancellation Guard
results.scenario: Attempt to cancel an order that has already been SETTLED at the Bank
results.expected: HTTP 400 Bad Request ("Cannot cancel order in status SETTLED")
results.actual: HTTP 400 - Cannot cancel order in status SETTLED.

evidence.error: Cannot cancel order in status SETTLED.
